title: Focus Halo
description: Một vòng sáng loang ra từ viền chủ thể rồi tắt, chủ thể phồng nhẹ 4 %, xung quanh đứng yên.

moworks.notes: Ring on the target's outline (radius R): scale 0.75 → 1.9, opacity 0.7 → 0, 2.5 px stroke plus a 10 px wide soft copy at 35 % of that opacity, 900 ms power2.out (easeOutCubic); the target bumps 1 → 1.04 → 1 (sine) over the first 450 ms. Centre still; neighbours untouched. Params: scale (0.75 → 1.9) · opacity đầu (0.7) · stroke (2.5 px) · bump (1.04) · duration (0.9 s).
